11. IP Addresses and Ports

An IP address identifies a network interface or logical endpoint; a port identifies a transport
endpoint on that host.

Q: Can two processes bind the same IP and TCP port normally?
A: Normally no; specific socket options and binding arrangements can be exceptions.
